blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala will enter the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games as the highest-ranked player in the women’s tennis field, and Cignal TV will air her matches so Filipino fans can follow the world No. 18’s campaign. Eala sits atop a women’s singles entry list thinned by the absence of several of Asia’s leading players, most notably defending Asian Games champion Zheng Qinwen of China and Indonesia’s Janice Tjen.
